title: Explainable AI-Powered Framework for Video-Based Skill Assessment in Cataract Surgery
summary: Persistent shortages in the surgical workforce and inherent limitations of traditional training methods highlight the necessity of automated, data-driven approaches in surgical education. This study addresses these challenges by introducing a novel, explainable AI-powered framework for automated skill assessment, specifically focusing on cataract surgery. We present the world's largest dataset of cataract surgery videos, comprising 2,000 recordings. Additionally, we propose an AI-powered analytical framework that employs advanced computer vision and signal-processing techniques to automatically evaluate surgical videos to derive objective, quantitative performance indicators that complement or potentially replace subjective scoring methods. A significant advantage of our framework over previous methods lies precisely in its explainability of outputs, elevating it beyond merely an opaque skill classification tool. Through experimental analysis of 83 cataract surgery videos, we demonstrate that the automatically computed metrics exhibit strong correlations with expert-based subjective evaluations, achieving up to 87% accuracy in surgical skill assessment. Each metric was individually examined, and expert surgeons provided subjective ratings using the newly introduced Capsulorhexis Skill Assessment System (CSAS). These subjective assessments were compared with ten objective motion-based metrics extracted through our framework. The results indicated a robust correlation between subjective ratings and automated indicators, underscoring the framework's capacity to accurately model surgical expertise.
tldr: This paper presents an explainable AI framework for automated skill assessment in cataract surgery using the world's largest dataset of 2,000 surgical videos, achieving up to 87% accuracy by correlating objective motion-based metrics with expert subjective ratings.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种可解释的人工智能框架，用于白内障手术的自动技能评估，使用了包含2000个手术视频的全球最大数据集，通过将客观运动指标与专家主观评分相关联，实现了高达87%的准确率。
summary_zh: 摘要：外科手术劳动力持续短缺以及传统培训方法的固有局限性，凸显了在外科教育中采用自动化、数据驱动方法的必要性。本研究通过引入一种新型的可解释人工智能驱动框架来应对这些挑战，该框架专注于白内障手术的自动技能评估。我们提出了目前全球最大的白内障手术视频数据集，包含2000段记录。此外，我们提出了一种基于人工智能的分析框架，该框架利用先进的计算机视觉和信号处理技术自动评估手术视频，从而得出客观、量化的绩效指标，以补充或潜在替代主观评分方法。与以往方法相比，本框架的一个显著优势在于其输出的可解释性，使其超越了一个不透明的技能分类工具。通过对83段白内障手术视频的实验分析，我们证明自动计算出的指标与基于专家的主观评价表现出强相关性，在手术技能评估中准确率高达87%。每个指标均经过单独检验，外科专家使用新引入的撕囊术技能评估系统（CSAS）提供主观评分。这些主观评估与通过我们的框架提取的十个基于运动的客观指标进行了比较。结果表明，主观评分与自动化指标之间存在稳健的相关性，凸显了该框架准确建模外科专业能力的能力。

title: Foundation Agents Meet Agentic Deep Research: Evidence-Grounded Clinical Code Forecasting
summary: Next-encounter ICD forecasting predicts which standardized diagnosis codes will be documented at a future visit from the longitudinal record available beforehand. The task is prospective and multi-label: the target note does not yet exist, and several codes may be correct. Structured EHR foundation models capture recurrence and temporal progression, whereas language foundation models generate flexible diagnostic hypotheses. We introduce ICD-Deepresearch, a DeepResearch workflow that composes these predictive foundation models with medical search and ICD dictionaries. Because no source reveals the future code set, research evaluates candidate transitions by linking patient evidence, external clinical relations, and exact code semantics under a fixed top-K budget. Candidate Generation uses SparseEHR to produce an EHR Prior that initializes two bounded Research Expansion rounds; an independent GPT-5 Direct Forecast supplies complementary candidates. Final Selection validates, deduplicates, and jointly ranks both paths, after which a separate module writes rationales without changing predictions. Finally ICD-Deepresearch achieves patient-averaged precision/recall of 24.60/35.09% on MIMIC-III and 25.14/48.32% on MIMIC-IV. Physicians rate 51% and 68% of its retrieved documents useful, compared with 22% and 39% for standalone GPT-5 web search and 32% and 41% for Medical Deep Research. ICD-Deepresearch therefore improves over the registered local comparators while retrieving evidence with higher physician-rated usefulness than the standalone research systems
tldr: ICD-Deepresearch composes structured EHR foundation models and language models with medical search and ICD dictionaries to forecast future diagnosis codes, achieving higher precision/recall than standalone systems and better physician-rated usefulness.
tldr_zh: ICD-Deepresearch 将结构化 EHR 基础模型与语言模型结合医学搜索和 ICD 词典，用于预测未来诊断代码，在准确率/召回率上优于独立系统，且医生评估的有用性更高。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
下一次就诊的ICD编码预测旨在根据预先获取的纵向记录，预测未来就诊时将被记录的标准化诊断代码。该任务是前瞻性且多标签的：目标记录尚不存在，且多个代码可能均为正确。结构化EHR基础模型捕捉复发与时间进展，而语言基础模型则生成灵活的诊断假设。我们提出ICD-Deepresearch——一种将上述预测基础模型与医学搜索及ICD词典相结合的DeepResearch工作流。由于任何来源均无法揭示未来的代码集，研究通过将患者证据、外部临床关系以及精确的代码语义在固定Top-K预算下进行关联，来评估候选转换。候选生成阶段使用SparseEHR生成EHR先验，以初始化两轮有界的研究扩展；独立的GPT-5直接预测提供补充候选。最终选择阶段对两条路径进行验证、去重及联合排序，之后由独立模块编写理由而不改变预测结果。最终，ICD-Deepresearch在MIMIC-III上实现了患者平均精确率/召回率24.60%/35.09%，在MIMIC-IV上实现了25.14%/48.32%。医生认为其检索到的文档中有51%和68%具有实用性，而单独GPT-5网络搜索为22%和39%，医学深度研究为32%和41%。因此，ICD-Deepresearch相较于已注册的本地对比方法有所改进，同时检索到的证据在医生评定的实用性上优于单独的研究系统。

title: Automated ACL Footprint Identification Using 3D Deep Learning
summary: One of the most common reasons for anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) reconstruction failure is femoral tunnel malpositioning (ACL footprint center and tunnel orientation). Such failures may lead to the development of meniscal pathology and osteoarthritis. Accurate ACL femoral footprint identification is therefore essential for precise tunnel placement, restoration of the native knee joint mechanics, post-surgical knee joint health and prevention of graft failure. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) bring new opportunities to improve image-guided orthopedic surgery. However, at present, existing AI research focuses primarily on ACL segmentation and rupture classification based on pre- and post-operative magnetic resonance (MR) images. Identification of the ACL footprint center using deep learning methods has not been thoroughly researched. Thus, the purpose of this study is to explore 3D deep learning models for ACL femoral footprint identification directly from 3D MR images. Two comprehensive 3D deep learning architectures were developed: a 3D graph convolutional neural network-based geometric model applied to 3D femoral meshes; and a 3D landmark-enhanced identification model based on 3D MR images. A total of 4883 right and 3087 left knee image sets were used from a publicly available database. Eighty percent (80%) were applied to model generation, and twenty percent (20%) were preserved for model testing. Both models achieved excellent performance; however, the image-based method outperformed the model-based method (average error of 2.1mm vs 2.8 mm). Thus, 3D deep learning provides a feasible clinical approach for ACL footprint localization and has the potential to improve ACL reconstruction footprint accuracy.
tldr: This paper proposes two 3D deep learning models (graph CNN on femoral meshes and landmark-enhanced CNN on MR images) to automatically identify the ACL femoral footprint center, achieving 2.1mm average error with the image-based method and demonstrating clinical feasibility for improving ACL reconstruction.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了两种3D深度学习模型（基于股骨网格的图卷积网络和基于MR图像的标志点增强网络）自动识别ACL股骨足迹中心，图像法平均误差2.1mm，展示了改善ACL重建的临床可行性。
summary_zh: 前交叉韧带（ACL）重建失败的最常见原因之一是股骨隧道定位不当（ACL足迹中心及隧道方向）。此类失败可能导致半月板病变和骨关节炎的发生。因此，准确识别ACL股骨足迹对于精确放置隧道、恢复原生膝关节力学功能、维持术后膝关节健康以及预防移植物失败至关重要。人工智能（AI）的最新进展为改善图像引导的骨科手术带来了新的机遇。然而，目前现有的AI研究主要基于术前和术后的磁共振（MR）图像进行ACL分割和断裂分类。利用深度学习方法识别ACL足迹中心尚未得到充分研究。因此，本研究的目的是探索直接从3D MR图像中识别ACL股骨足迹的3D深度学习模型。我们开发了两种综合性的3D深度学习架构：一种基于3D图卷积神经网络的几何模型，应用于3D股骨网格；另一种基于3D MR图像的3D标志点增强识别模型。本研究使用了来自公开数据库的共4883个右膝和3087个左膝图像数据集。其中80%用于模型生成，20%保留用于模型测试。两种模型均表现出优异的性能；然而，基于图像的方法优于基于模型的方法（平均误差为2.1毫米对比2.8毫米）。因此，3D深度学习为ACL足迹定位提供了一种可行的临床方法，并具有提高ACL重建足迹精度的潜力。

title: Beyond Instrument Motion: Recognizing Tissue Tension Toward Surgical Skill Assessment
summary: Surgical performance assessment in minimally invasive surgery largely relies on manual expert review, making it time-consuming, subjective, and difficult to scale. While existing surgical video understanding methods address tasks such as instrument segmentation, surgical phase recognition, and action recognition, they do not explicitly capture fine-grained tissue handling, a key indicator of surgical quality. To address this gap, we introduce tissue tension recognition, a new clinically motivated video understanding task for laparoscopic and robot-assisted rectal cancer surgery. To support this task, we construct SurgTension, the first expert-annotated tissue tension dataset, providing a benchmark for objective tissue tension recognition. We further propose TensionTRAC, a lightweight trajectory-based framework that models tissue tension from sparse point trajectories. Using a compact trajectory encoder, TensionTRAC achieves competitive performance against strong pretrained video backbones.
tldr: This paper introduces tissue tension recognition as a new task for surgical skill assessment, constructs the first expert-annotated dataset SurgTension, and proposes a lightweight trajectory-based framework TensionTRAC that models tissue tension from sparse point trajectories, achieving competitive performance.
tldr_zh: 本文引入组织张力识别作为手术技能评估的新任务，构建了首个专家标注的数据集 SurgTension，并提出轻量级基于轨迹的框架 TensionTRAC，通过稀疏点轨迹建模组织张力，取得有竞争力的性能。
summary_zh: 摘要：微创手术中的手术表现评估主要依赖专家人工评审，导致过程耗时、主观性强且难以规模化推广。现有手术视频分析方法虽可处理器械分割、手术阶段识别和动作识别等任务，但未能明确捕捉精细的组织操作——这一衡量手术质量的关键指标。为填补该空白，我们提出组织张力识别这一新的临床导向视频理解任务，适用于腹腔镜和机器人辅助直肠癌手术。为支撑该任务，我们构建了SurgTension——首个专家标注的组织张力数据集，为客观识别组织张力提供基准。在此基础上，我们进一步提出TensionTRAC，一种轻量级基于轨迹的框架，通过稀疏点轨迹对组织张力进行建模。借助紧凑的轨迹编码器，TensionTRAC能够以较小的计算开销取得与强预训练视频骨干网络相媲美的性能。

title: SpurCon: Weighted Supervised Contrastive Learning for Mitigating Spurious Cues in Medical Imaging
summary: Despite the rapid progress of deep neural networks in visual recognition, their adoption in high-risk medical applications remains limited due to reliability and robustness concerns. Models may exploit spurious correlations, particularly in medical imaging, where devices or treatment artifacts often co-occur with pathology. In small or imbalanced datasets, such cues further reduce worst-group performance and undermine clinical trust. To solve these issues, two major challenges should be addressed: identifying dataset-specific spurious cues, which typically require domain knowledge, and mitigating reliance on them. To tackle both, we propose SpurCon, a lightweight framework based on a novel supervised contrastive loss formulation that leverages available metadata and predicted spurious labels to enhance robustness. We introduce a fast few-shot procedure, without network training, to estimate spurious labels using a small number of expert-annotated samples. We then propose a weighted supervised contrastive objective, WtSupCon, that reshapes the representation geometry by assigning sample-specific weights that depend on the [pathology, spurious, metadata] combination. For example, the highest weight is assigned to samples that differ only in their spurious label. This yields highly similar representations for images with the same metadata and pathology, differing only in the predicted spurious label. Our method operates on pretrained image encoders (such as BiomedCLIP) and trains only a lightweight projection head. We evaluate SpurCon on a synthetic setting and on Waterbirds, CheXpert, a chest X-ray classification dataset, and ISIC 2020, a skin cancer classification dataset. Our approach delivers the best spurious-mitigation performance, balancing well worst-group and overall accuracy on multiple datasets.
tldr: Proposes SpurCon, a lightweight framework using weighted supervised contrastive learning and few-shot spurious label estimation to mitigate spurious correlations in medical imaging, achieving balanced worst-group and overall accuracy.
tldr_zh: 提出SpurCon，一种轻量级框架，通过加权监督对比学习和少量样本的虚假标签估计来缓解医学影像中的虚假相关性，在多个数据集上平衡了最差组和整体准确率。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
尽管深度神经网络在视觉识别领域取得了快速进展，但由于可靠性和鲁棒性问题，其在高风险医疗应用中的采用仍然有限。模型可能利用虚假相关性，尤其是在医学影像中，设备或治疗伪影常常与病理特征同时出现。在小规模或不平衡的数据集中，这些线索进一步降低了最差组别的性能，并削弱了临床信任。为解决这些问题，需要应对两个主要挑战：识别数据集特定的虚假线索（通常需要领域知识），以及减少对它们的依赖。为同时应对这两点，我们提出了SpurCon，这是一种基于新颖的监督对比损失公式的轻量级框架，利用可用的元数据和预测的虚假标签来增强鲁棒性。我们引入了一种无需网络训练的快速少样本流程，通过少量专家标注样本估计虚假标签。随后，我们提出了一种加权监督对比目标函数WtSupCon，通过根据[病理、虚假、元数据]组合分配样本特定权重来重塑表征几何结构。例如，最高权重分配给仅在虚假标签上存在差异的样本。这使得具有相同元数据和病理、仅因预测的虚假标签不同的图像能够产生高度相似的表征。我们的方法在预训练图像编码器（如BiomedCLIP）上运行，仅训练一个轻量级的投影头。我们在合成场景以及Waterbirds、CheXpert（胸部X射线分类数据集）和ISIC 2020（皮肤癌分类数据集）上评估了SpurCon。我们的方法在多个数据集上实现了最佳的虚假相关性缓解性能，较好地平衡了最差组别准确率和总体准确率。

title: Lymphocyte Mimicry Correction via Region-Level Tissue Reasoning and Unbalanced Optimal Transport
summary: Cell mimicry arises when different cell types appear morphologically similar. Human pathologists resolve this ambiguity using surrounding tissue context, whereas current vision models either lack contextual reasoning (cell foundation models) or cannot operate at the cell level (pathology MLLMs). We present Loki-OT, which propagates region-level tissue reasoning to individual cell predictions via Unbalanced Optimal Transport, using MLLM-derived density priors as soft guidance for ambiguous cell reassignment. Loki-OT is motivated by the observation that pretrained cell foundation model features already encode discriminative information, including tissue context, but standard cell-level supervision fails to use tissue context effectively. The resulting transport plan is distilled into a lightweight student MLP classifier that learns context-aware decision boundaries within the pretrained feature space. On the independent TCGA-BRCA cohort, Loki-OT achieved lower patient-level MAE than the fully supervised in-domain PanopTILs classifier and improved F1 in epithelium-rich mimicry tissues, using 278 weak region-level MLLM estimates built on a general-domain cell foundation model. Code: https://github.com/xiangli980/Lymphocyte_Mimicry_Correction_via_Loki_OT
tldr: Loki-OT uses unbalanced optimal transport to propagate region-level tissue reasoning from MLLMs to correct lymphocyte mimicry at the cell level, achieving better results than fully supervised classifiers on breast cancer tissue.
tldr_zh: Loki-OT利用不平衡最优传输将多模态大语言模型的区域级组织推理传播到细胞级别，以纠正淋巴细胞模仿问题，在乳腺癌组织上取得了优于全监督分类器的结果。
summary_zh:
摘要：
当不同细胞类型在形态上相似时，便会产生细胞拟态现象。人类病理学家通过周围组织背景来消除这种歧义，而当前的视觉模型要么缺乏背景推理能力（细胞基础模型），要么无法在细胞层级进行操作（病理学多模态大语言模型）。我们提出Loki-OT方法，通过非平衡最优传输将区域级组织推理传播至单个细胞预测，并利用多模态大语言模型导出的密度先验作为模糊细胞重新分配的软指导。Loki-OT的动机源于以下观察：预训练的细胞基础模型特征已编码包括组织背景在内的判别性信息，但标准细胞级监督未能有效利用组织背景。所得到的最优传输方案被蒸馏至一个轻量级学生多层感知机分类器中，使其在预训练特征空间内学习到具备背景感知能力的决策边界。在独立TCGA-BRCA队列上，Loki-OT的患者层级平均绝对误差低于全监督领域内模型PanopTILs分类器，并在富含上皮细胞的拟态组织中F1分数得到提升，其仅需基于通用领域细胞基础模型构建的278个弱监督区域级多模态大语言模型估计。代码：https://github.com/xiangli980/Lymphocyte_Mimicry_Correction_via_Loki_OT

title: Beyond Suspicious Steps: Ontological Trust in Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Long-horizon agents increasingly operate across many steps, tools, and observa- tions. In this setting, the relevant oversight question is not only whether each action is locally valid, but whether the evolving trajectory still corresponds to the task the user authorized. Drift can accumulate quietly: an agent may call the right tool with plausible arguments at every step, while its prefix moves toward a broader role, an adjacent objective, or evidence the user never supplied. Existing monitors mostly check local compliance, deliver final-trace verdicts, or score generic risk; they do not directly estimate this prefix-level relation. We introduce ontological trust, a task-conditioned property of trajectory prefixes, and instantiate it as RGE, an online monitor that decomposes trust along Role, Goal, and Evidence. RGE uses LLMs only to derive structured task and step representations; trust-state updates, projec- tions, and intervention decisions are deterministic, so the output is a replayable and auditable trust trajectory rather than a single end-to-end judge verdict. We construct a cross-domain trajectory corpus from OSWorld, FinanceBench, and EICU-AC, covering benign executions, prefix-paired drift, and pseudo-consistency failures. On this corpus, RGE outperforms adapted rule-, judge-, and shield-style baselines on prefix-paired drift detection. With the two larger estimator models, it exceeds 93% Drift F1 on every benchmark while keeping benign coverage at or above 95.8%. Pseudo-consistency is harder: detection depends on whether task completion is externally visible, a structural limit we characterize empirically.
tldr: The paper proposes 'ontological trust' as a measure of whether an agent's trajectory prefix still aligns with the user's authorized task, and introduces RGE, an online monitor that decomposes trust along Role, Goal, and Evidence to detect drift before it becomes severe.
tldr_zh: 本文提出“本体论信任”（ontological trust）概念，用于衡量智能体的轨迹前缀是否仍与用户授权的任务一致，并引入RGE在线监控器，沿角色、目标和证据三个维度分解信任，以在漂移变得严重之前进行检测。
summary_zh: 长时域智能体正越来越多地在多步骤、多工具和多观测场景中运行。在此背景下，相关的监督问题不仅在于每个动作在局部是否有效，更在于演化中的轨迹是否仍对应于用户授权的任务。漂移可能悄然累积：智能体可能在每一步都使用看似合理的参数调用正确的工具，但其前缀却逐渐转向更宽泛的角色、邻近的目标或用户从未提供的证据。现有监控器大多检查局部合规性、给出最终轨迹判定或评估通用风险；它们并未直接估计这种前缀级关系。我们引入本体论信任——一种任务条件化的轨迹前缀属性，并将其具体化为RGE，这是一种在线监控器，沿角色、目标和证据维度分解信任。RGE仅使用LLM来推导结构化的任务和步骤表示；信任状态更新、投影和干预决策均为确定性过程，因此输出是可重放、可审计的信任轨迹，而非单一端到端的裁判判定。我们从OSWorld、FinanceBench和EICU-AC构建了一个跨域轨迹语料库，涵盖良性执行、前缀配对漂移以及伪一致性失败。在该语料库上，RGE在前缀配对漂移检测中优于经过适配的规则、裁判和护盾类基线。使用两个较大的评估模型时，RGE在每项基准上的漂移F1分数超过93%，同时保持良性覆盖率不低于95.8%。伪一致性检测更具挑战性：其检测能力取决于任务完成是否在外部可见——我们通过实验刻画了这一结构限制。
